config.runtime.path: Path to the dsh executable. When empty, `dsh` is looked up on `PATH` (the command installed by DeepSeek Desktop, or `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`).
config.runtime.profile: dsh profile to start. Defaults to `web`, which shares models, API keys and permission presets with your own `dsh web`.
config.context.includeActiveEditor: Attach the active editor to messages by default: the selected code with line numbers when there is a selection, otherwise just the file path (dsh reads the file when it needs to). Each message can opt out with the chip above the input box.
config.ui.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Chinese for Chinese, English otherwise)
config.title: DSH
container.title: DSH
extension.description: Codex-style VS Code front end for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
capabilities.untrusted: dsh reads and writes files and runs commands in the workspace, so the workspace must be trusted.
